summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $780K in annual savings with nearly $500K already implemented
summary.narrative: Through a focused 5-month engagement, Treya Partners delivered $492K in fully-implemented savings and a further $288K moving through final implementation across eight actively-sourced categories. Major wins include renegotiating Athena billing rates, consolidating medical-supply distributors, and converting outsourced sonography to an in-house model. Additional savings are pending final contracts for lab services, IT managed services, and Hologic lab reagents. The project is also driving process improvements such as standardized IUD purchasing policies and strengthened recruiting capabilities.
